meta.subject: A feature matrix on one page as wide and as tall as it needs

layout.text: What each library documents about itself, checked on 2026-11-07. Lpdf is v0.34.0. The ten others are one or two on-premises options per language, chosen for their track record and for how close they are to Lpdf's model, so a niche one such as Apache FOP sits beside the widely used. No hosted services and nothing that takes HTML as input.

layout.text: Competitor cells say what the library documents, not what a test showed. n/d is not proof that a feature is absent. The rows are not weighted, so the counts at the foot are not a ranking. Lpdf's own cells come from its changelog and docs at v0.34.0, and it is the youngest column by years: its first release notes are from October 2026.
